questions.topic: eGurukul · Mnemonics to Remember Cancer Staging
questions.stem: A 56-year-old female who initially presented with symptoms like nausea and vomiting and features suggesting irritable bowel syndrome water later after a battery of investigations was diagnosed to have an ovarian tumor. On surgical staging of the tumor, the tumor was confined to both the ovaries with capsule intact. What will the FIGO staging of the tumor be?
